_sobre: Artes de abertura dos capítulos (PixelLab create_image_pixflux, 384×128). Ninjas originais no visual do anime/mangá de Naruto (hitaiate, coletes, vilas e símbolos fiéis); nenhum personagem canônico. O prompt final é cena + estilo.
estilo: , Naruto anime style, original ninja characters, wide panoramic scene, pixel art, crisp pixels, vibrant anime colors, detailed background

capitulos.prompt: four young genin ninjas with leaf village forehead protectors sitting around a campfire in a dark forest at night, one reading an old open scroll, fireflies, tall trees
